thread:
jordan: heads-up — we're hitting ALB target group count limits in eu-west-1 while provisioning new private endpoints for the dedicated GPU fleet. stack creation failed with `TooManyTargetGroups`. Need a quota bump for Target groups per load balancer and possibly Internal load balancers per VPC. Can someone escalate to AWS? @infra @tanya

tanya: saw the same error on staging this morning. Is this ALB-only or do we have NLBs in the mix? can we consolidate target groups short-term? :thinking_face:

infra-eng: these are internal ALBs behind private endpoints for tenant isolation. Rough estimate: +300 TGs required immediately across the rollout (spread across 3 AZs). Short-term ask: increase Target groups per load balancer to 2000 in eu-west-1. Also request bump for Internal load balancers per VPC to 50.

sre-lead: file an AWS Support case (service-code `elasticloadbalancing`). Include account id `123456789012`, region `eu-west-1`, and the exact quota codes if possible. I'll attach the runbook and mark as P2.

oncall-bot: Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/load-balancer-quotas — follow the "request quota" steps and add architecture diagram + expected growth numbers.

tanya: copying proposed text for the case: "Request increase of Target groups per load balancer to 2000 and Internal load balancers per VPC to 50 in eu-west-1 to support private endpoints for the dedicated GPU fleet rollout (account 123456789012). Current rollout requires ~300 additional target groups immediately and growth to ~1200 over 3 months)." ok to submit?

infra-eng: that wording is good. Also mention service name is Elastic Load Balancing and include the impact: deployment failures, delayed tenant onboarding.

tanya: submitted. Case ID: `3456789012`. AWS initial ETA 48-72h. Link: https://console.aws.amazon.com/support/cases#/case/?caseId=3456789012 :thumbsup:

jordan: nice — thanks. any workaround while we wait? can we route new private endpoints to NLBs temporarily?

infra-eng: possible but NLBs lack host-based routing and certain ALB features we rely on (host + path rules). We could provision per-service NLBs but that's higher ops overhead and increases target counts in other quotas. Not ideal.

aws-support-bot: Automated: Received case `3456789012`. Initial review complete; case forwarded to Elastic Load Balancing team. Reference quota codes: `L-6E4B6B0F` (Target groups per load balancer), `L-2A3B4C5D` (Load balancers per VPC - internal).

sre-lead: thanks — tanya please paste any updates from AWS here. marking this thread P2 and tagging infra rotation.

tanya: will do. quick cheat for anyone who needs to reproduce the request via CLI:```bash
aws service-quotas request-service-quota-increase --service-code elasticloadbalancing --quota-code L-6E4B6B0F --desired-value 2000 --region eu-west-1
```

jordan: noted. leaving a TODO to audit target-group churn and see if we can reduce short-term creation rate. :eyes:
